description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 325 Sandy Bottoms 30A,”at High Pointe Resort located in Seacrest Beach. Wake up to Gulf views, soak in the beauty of a lagoon-style pool, and feel the sand between your toes just steps from your door. This 3-suite condo offers the perfect blend of luxury and laid-back vibes. Stroll to nearby dining, explore charming shops, or simply unwind in paradise. Bring the family and create memories that last forever. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Breathtaking Gulf and Pool Views from the 3rd-Floor Balcony – Feel the tranquility as you soak in stunning ocean views and enjoy effortless access to the serene resort pool—perfect for unwinding or starting your day with a refreshing dip.Nestled in High Pointe Resort with World-Class Amenities – Indulge in luxury with access to a 6,500 sq. ft. lagoon-style pool, a tropical tiki bar for laid-back vibes, a relaxing hot tub, and a playful playground for family fun.Steps Away from Shopping and Dining at Peddlers Pavilion and Rosemary Beach – Immerse yourself in the vibrant community, where charming boutiques and mouthwatering dining options await just a short stroll away.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup Included (March to October) – Relax in style with complimentary beach chairs, ensuring a stress-free and comfortable day by the shore during the sunny seasons.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The property exceeded expectations—spotless, incredibly spacious, and just a quick stroll to the beach. Absolutely perfect for large groups looking for comfort and convenience!" – Michael⭐"Great location and plenty of space for our family! Would highly recommend for a relaxing stay near the beach." – Amir⭐"Beautiful home with lots of space and attentive management. Loved the short walk to the beach and the included bikes!" – Maegan*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a bright, open-concept living space thoughtfully designed for both comfort and connection. Sink into plush, cozy seating as you enjoy your favorite shows on a large flat-screen TV, or slide open the glass doors to the expansive balcony. Here, you'll be greeted with breathtaking views of the Gulf and the sparkling resort pool—a picture-perfect retreat for relaxing after a sun-soaked beach day. Every detail invites you to unwind and savor the beauty around you.Expansive living room featuring comfortable seating and stunning pool viewsOversized flat-screen TV paired with sliding balcony access, complete with elegant seating and a dining table for 4Bright and airy open-concept design, perfect for unforgettable family gatherings*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The beautifully designed kitchen offers both bar seating and a spacious dining table, perfect for enjoying effortless meals or savoring your morning coffee. Whether you’re preparing a quick breakfast, crafting a gourmet dinner, or hosting friends, this fully equipped space has everything you need to make your stay comfortable and memorable.Fully equipped kitchen with top-of-the-line modern appliances for all your cooking needsElegant bar seating for 4 paired with a chic dining table for 4, perfect for meals or gatheringsPerfectly designed for creating gourmet dishes or enjoying mouthwatering takeout from nearby acclaimed restaurants*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each bedroom offers plush bedding, premium linens, and elegant décor for ultimate comfort. Bathrooms feature spa-like rainfall showers, ample counter space, and curated amenities to refresh and revitalize.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and shower/tub combo.King Guest Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo.Bunk Room: Twin over Full Bunk Bed and Full Bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hall access.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort provides exceptional amenities to make your stay unforgettable. Relax by the stunning community pool, enjoy delicious coastal cuisine at Crabby Steve's, or discover charming boutique shops just moments away.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a Large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Experience the charm of Seacrest Beach, where tranquility blends seamlessly with excitement. Stroll over to Peddlers Pavilion for unique boutiques and delicious eats, browse the upscale shops of nearby Rosemary Beach, or take a quick trip to the iconic town of Seaside for unforgettable coastal vibes.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 219642
